details.report:
Implemented the owner-assigned Reviewer verification policy as commit 0580c9e (`fix(reviewer): prohibit duplicate verification battery`).

Changes:
- Added one package-owned policy constant at `src/reviewer-verification-policy.ts`.
- Injected it at the parent Reviewer recipe/system-prompt boundary in `src/reviewer-role.ts`.
- Injected the same policy into each actual Reviewer child system prompt in `src/reviewer-agent.ts`.
- Left Reviewer Soul, canonical code-review Skill, orchestration, model policy, and tool surfaces unchanged; retained bash without a command blacklist.

TDD evidence:
- RED: `node --import tsx --test test/reviewer-role.test.ts test/reviewer-agent.test.ts` failed 3 focused assertions because parent and actual child prompts lacked the policy (23 pass, 3 fail).
- GREEN: the same command passed all 26 focused tests.

Bounded verification:
- `npm run typecheck` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed after whitespace correction.
- Same-pattern/behavior check: the focused child integration test observed the policy in every captured Standards/Spec child request while retaining two concurrent sibling legs, distinct persisted session IDs, inherited provider/model dispatch, and the exact seven-child-tool surface. Existing focused parent tests continued to prove exact native Skill provenance/expansion and accepted output protocol.
- Introduced-regression check: all 26 affected Reviewer role/agent tests passed; no full station was run, per owner instruction.
- Working tree was clean after commit.
